content.comment_body: Hello forum, I am using a [product_name] PLC with order number [article_no], along with a connection cable, order number [article_no], and the [product_name] Demo software [version_no]. When I attempt to connect, the "PC to [product_name]" symbol doesn't appear. Restarting the PLC’s power doesn’t resolve this. Could anyone assist with this issue so I can upload/download my program? Regards, [user_name]

Hi, This setup will not function because you have the demo version of [product_name] software, which does not allow upload or download to a [product_name] PLC. You’ll need the official version for this capability. Regards
Dear [user_name], Thanks for your advice, I will give it a try. Regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Forum users have discovered that the demo edition of the [product_name] software restricts them from uploading or downloading programs to a [product_name] PLC. There’s no clear warning of this limitation until users attempt a connection, resulting in confusion and wasted time.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipated that the demo software would allow at least basic upload/download operations with the [product_name] PLC and expected the software to provide clear feedback on connection issues.
